Rae (CS): kicking off AuroraEdge dedicated bring-up. Goal: steady p99 <250ms for chat and embeddings. customer warmup window Fri morning.
Noah (SRE): traffic estimates: 350 req/min steady, bursts to ~1k/min. initial quota ask = 10 GPUs sustained, plan headroom to 14.
Ellen (Infra): suggest autoscale policy: min_instances=10, max_instances=18, scale up when p95_token_latency>110ms for 2m, scale down after 8m idle. Enable prefix caching.
Rae (CS): customer wants a deterministic warmup that primes KV and token caches. Can we run a 3-step soak?
Noah (SRE): propose: 1) prefix replay top-2k prompts @ 6 qps for 60m; 2) embedding bulk 120k vectors in 1k batches; 3) chat ramp 0->burst in 25m hold 45m. We'll collect p50/p95/p99 + GPU util.
TestBot: queued loadtest job_id=tb-aurora-451, start=2028-06-02T08:00Z
Jon (Acct): FYI renewal in 11 months. If soak shows sustained p99 regressions flag as renewal risk and possible upsell for reserved capacity. Capture feature asks during enablement.
Rae (CS): planning enablement demo day after soak (30m runbook + rollback drills). Noah to run demo.
Ellen (Infra): I'll produce autoscale JSON and enable 4h KV retention.
Noah (SRE): after test posts results here with traces using ./fetch_traces --job tb-aurora-451 --metrics p50,p95,p99,gpu_util
Rae (CS): action items: Noah run soak and paste traces (Fri EOD), Ellen finalize autoscale and caches, Jon document renewal flags. If p99 > 400ms we'll escalate to larger capacity (cost impact). :warning:
Jon (Acct): will loop in finance/legal if we need contract changes.
Rae (CS): thanks team 44d will update thread with outputs and customer feedback.
